subject.title: Add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Should Gitcrawl accept `fill-pr-details` as a new top-level command with the proposed limit, order, batch-size, reserve-rate-limit, JSON progress, and include-comments behavior after the branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing CLI contract and quota policy, and automation cannot choose the permanent command shape or decide whether the current conflicting branch should be refreshed and landed.

options.title: Accept after refresh and tests
options.body: Refresh the PR on current main, preserve the merged coverage command, run focused CLI/store tests, and accept this as the first supported bounded fill surface.

options.title: Request CLI-shape changes
options.body: Ask for specific changes to flags, defaults, output fields, or quota behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause bounded fill
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers want a different hydration workflow first.

recommendation.title: Accept after refresh and tests
recommendation.body: Refresh the PR on current main, preserve the merged coverage command, run focused CLI/store tests, and accept this as the first supported bounded fill surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across PR-detail caching, sync hydration, shared rate-limit behavior, and recent release stewardship for this area.
